title: Brazilian-Style Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful dish inspired by the cuisine of Brazil, featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together malai yogurt, zesty lime juice, and sweet honey.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Thread the marinated chicken onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked through.
7. Brush with sweet honey during the last minute of grilling.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
